output.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.item_count), 2) AS avg_items_per_order FROM marts.fct_orders o WHERE o.is_revenue = true AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: Average of item_count (total units per order) over completed orders (is_revenue = true) placed in calendar/fiscal year 2025.
